scope: Production OCREngine constructor/run and ordering/batching/index/filter/cleanup; model loading, detection, crop, recognition and Mat boundaries mocked. No JNI, native allocation or inference executed.

cases.name: a later batch failure keeps previous batches released and closes its partial batch()
a later crop failure releases earlier crops and the page while preserving the error()
dimension failure releases the returned crop before it can enter the recognition list()
empty crops and low scores do not shift accepted text to another source box()
no detections release the page without cropping or recognition()
recognition failure releases the prepared batch and preserves its error()
successful aspect batches keep reading order and release every crop once()
